summary: IQVIA Holdings Inc. subsidiary IQVIA Inc. issued €950 million in 4.625% senior notes due 2033 via an indenture dated June 11, 2026. The unsecured notes bear interest semi-annually, mature June 15, 2033, and are redeemable subject to a make-whole premium. Net proceeds will refinance existing indebtedness and pay fees. This is an ordinary debt refinancing transaction, not a special situation event for equity holders. The filing is a routine capital markets activity, so watch for no arbitrage angle; it simply reduces interest cost.
